camel_example: aliyun smartag CreateSmartAccessGatewaySoftware --region cn-hangzhou --ChargeType PREPAY --UserCount 5 --DataPlan 5 --Period 12 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AutoPay false --version 2018-03-13 --method POST --force
description_en: Creates a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) app instance
description_zh: 调用CreateSmartAccessGatewaySoftware创建智能接入网关APP实例
kebab_example: aliyun smartag create-smart-access-gateway-software --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --period 12 --auto-pay false --charge-type PREPAY --user-count 5 --data-plan 5 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSmartAccessGatewaySoftware

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Smart Access Gateway app instance
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关APP实例的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The purchase duration of the Smart Access Gateway app instance. Unit: months. Valid values: 1 to 9, 12, 24, and 36
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关APP实例的购买时长，单位：月。
取值：1~9、12、24、36
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment for the bills of the Smart Access Gateway app instance. Valid values:

true: yes.
false (default): no.

If you set this parameter to false, you must go to the Orders page in the console to complete the payment after you invoke this operation. Otherwise, the instance cannot be created
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动支付智能接入网关APP实例的账单。取值：

true：是。
false（默认值）：否。

如果您选择不自动支付账单，在您调用本接口后，请前往控制台的订单中心完成支付，实例才能创建成功
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: The billing method of the Smart Access Gateway app instance. Valid value: PREPAY (upfront). This value serves as an identity indicating that the Smart Access Gateway app instance is a resource that requires upfront payment before use
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关APP实例的计费类型，取值：PREPAY，预付费。标识智能接入网关APP实例为先付费后使用的资源
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en: The number of client accounts for the Smart Access Gateway app instance
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关APP实例的客户端账号数量规格
parameters.name: user_count

parameters.help_en:
The monthly data plan provided for each client account. Unit: GB. Valid value: 5.

Currently, only a free monthly data plan of 5 GB is supported for each client account
parameters.help_zh:
系统每月赠送给每个客户端账号的流量套餐规格，单位：GB。取值：5。

目前仅支持每月赠送给每个客户端账号5 GB的流量套餐
parameters.name: data_plan

schema.description_en: The order information of the Smart Access Gateway app instance
schema.description_zh: 智能接入网关APP实例订单信息

OrderId.description_en: The order ID for purchasing the Smart Access Gateway app instance
OrderId.description_zh: 购买智能接入网关APP实例的订单号

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the Smart Access Gateway app instance belongs
ResourceGroupId.description_zh: 智能接入网关APP实例所属资源组ID

SmartAGId.description_en: The instance ID of the Smart Access Gateway app
